sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:39

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:39:1
items.html: Upper light was also added to them: For besides what they had from the beginning of their emanation, from the coupling of the Nikvey Einayim, a whole Partzuf of Gadlut also reached them through the coupling of AB and SAG. The first light is called by the name the essence of their emanation, and the second light is called by the name “addition.” And this is what he says: upper light was added to them.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:39:2
items.html: And they had no strength to receive it, etc.: For the vessels were too small to contain that great light that came in the discernment of the addition. For this light was of the discernment of GAR, while their vessels began from Bina downward (as above, page 416, the passage beginning “And HBD”). And therefore they did not endure, until the new MA came and joined them with itself, and the vessels grew, and then they endured, as written in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:39:3
items.html: The GAR, their vessels had the strength to receive their light. That is, their light precisely, what they had from the beginning of their emanation, namely the first light mentioned in the adjacent item. But the second light, which is called by the name addition, did not endure even in the GAR. And this is the annulment of the posterior of AVI and the flaw in the NHY of Keter that the ARI brings above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:39:4
items.html: When they came out from the secret of Akudim, etc., and were divided into ten Nekudin, then was their emergence, and they died at once. For at first all the lights came (50) and were included in the vessel of Keter of the Nekudim; and this vessel is still considered Akudim, that is, the discernment of the Partzuf SAG, because it has in it phase two of clothing (as above, page 413, the passage beginning “Now you will understand.” Study it there well); and it has in it the self of the light of the Ozen. However, afterwards, through the illumination of the Yesod of AK, the NHY of this Keter expanded into AVI, and AVI turned face to face and coupled in the secret of the MAN of the bottom Hey, in the secret of the point that Aba takes, and the great coupling was made in the secret of the look of the Einayim of AVI in one another, as written in its place. And then, when this great light expanded from above downward to the vessels of the Nekudim, that is, to be divided into ten Nekudim — for each and every vessel was comprised of ten, as is known in the secret of the 320 sparks — they immediately broke and died, in the secret of “like those sparks that the craftsman strikes out of the iron, and sparks come out and are extinguished at once.” And they are 320 sparks. For every king is comprised of four discernments, Hochma, Bina, Tifferet and Malchut, and in each discernment there were ten Nekudot; hence forty sparks for each king, and they are eight kings, hence eight times forty, which is 320. And this is the secret of the 320 sparks mentioned in all the places, as is further written in its place.
